chunks: "Indeed, I shave every Jumu'ah, from one application of depilatory to the next."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الطَّلْيَةِ: application of depilatory substance used for hair removal

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about grooming and cleanliness on Jumu'ah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام maintained regular bodily grooming on every Jumu'ah. It indicates the importance of cleanliness, beautification, and periodic personal care in connection with the etiquette of Friday.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.286 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"I indeed shave (the head) every Jumu’ah, from one washing to the next."
